checked.fact: Original tokenizer, byte-size, parenthesis/root and >128 nesting checks remain in the uncached derivation. Every memo call re-encodes and checks the current MAX_BYTES before a hit. Exact input text is the key; comments/quotes/Unicode are not normalized.
Policy binds current TOKEN, size/cache bounds, uncached parser callable and its code object; a changed tokenizer or parser body clears prior syntax. TOKEN is the current immutable compiled regex.

The stored AST consists of immutable tuples and string atoms. First return is the separate newly parsed mutable tree; every hit recursively creates fresh mutable lists. A caller list mutation cannot modify the stored tree.

Nested sessions intentionally share entries; parse errors, propagated exceptions and cancellation clear entries, byte and node counters. Outer exit clears all retained trees and resets the ContextVar. Policy-only references remain without retained input/AST.

An individually oversized legal memo input or node census bypasses storage rather than adding a parser rejection. Successful insertion evicts oldest entries until aggregate raw-byte, node and entry bounds hold.
read still stats and reads the file on every call. No file/stat, validation, source, tool or receipt result is memoized by this change.

The readback session composes the pure parse session only. Explicit and marked Improve children, comparison contexts and marked Native7 parents retain existing uncached semantic-reader paths; no caller or execution Budget authority is newly cached.

focused_test_review.coverage: Actual uncached-call counting; returned-list isolation; operation exit; nested handled exception and KeyboardInterrupt; malformed parses clearing; tokenizer/MAX_BYTES/parser code replacement; byte/node/entry eviction and bypass; same-size current file reads; comments/Unicode/quoted atoms and unknown fields.
small_useful_additions_if_needed: Check exact current nesting acceptance boundary and the next rejected depth, rather than only a much deeper rejected input.
After warming multibyte text, lower MAX_BYTES to its UTF-8 boundary to make byte-vs-character handling explicit.

Existing semantic readback tests should continue to exercise same-size material mutation and late PRL faults with this session composed; no new Native authority fixture is required for pure syntax reuse.

identity_limit_assessment.bounded_future_controls: If a parser replacement/wrapper with meaningful optional defaults is intentionally supported, bind those defaults or bypass memo for that replacement. A small regression can establish the chosen contract; do not silently claim arbitrary mutable wrapper/closure state is bound.
identity_limit_assessment.current_parser_defaults: _parse_uncached has only the required text parameter, with no optional/default or keyword-only parameters. It is always invoked with text. Mutating its current defaults/kwdefaults alone cannot change this body result. Missing defaults in this new key is not a concrete bypass for this implementation.
identity_limit_assessment.helper_hot_replacement: Function replacement of freeze/thaw invalidates because their callable objects are in policy. Their in-place code mutation is not separately keyed. These are new internal memo helpers rather than the original parser; broad hostile hot-patching of helper internals is outside this source-only acceptance review. If lead promises helper-code invalidation, add code-object fields and one focused test rather than a generic signature framework.

memory_limit_assessment.fact: These are aggregate raw-input and tree-node limits, not an 8MiB total-Python-heap ceiling. Text keys and string atoms plus tuple/dict/container overhead remain additionally allocated, but their population and lengths are bounded by input bytes, nodes and entries for the actual parser. No node/entry growth beyond these counters was found.
memory_limit_assessment.qualification_limit: Actual peak RSS and whole review wall/fullCPU remain unmeasured here. Existing outer resource guards and review cap are unchanged.

reviewer: AI source reviewer; not human PCB review
verdict: No material correctness or acceptance blocker found in the current fixed parser implementation. Proceed only through lead-owned focused regressions and measured fresh review qualification; no performance or Native pass is established by this review.
